common_defaults: All cases are independent, fictional and advisory. Unless explicitly overridden: profiles P/Q/W/E have known immutable synthetic identities (profile-id, codex-harness, synthetic-provider, synthetic-model, revision r1, tools-output-config c1), authorized public-data destinations, fresh task qualification, active required tools/modalities, sufficient tested context and compatible output. All required objective checks are available; no preexisting stop rule or pending workflow gate exists. Known conservative all-in cost is 0.04 for direct and 0.09 for delegation; free cash=1.00, calls used=0, reserved=0, limit=6. Synthetic now is 2030-01-01T00:01:40Z and deadline is 2030-01-01T00:05:00Z. Host accounting is reliable. No human checkpoint, speculative opt-in or nesting is enabled. No output authorizes an actual effect. A case overrides only the facts it explicitly changes. Decimal equality must be respected.
limitations: generated unseen tasks, not an independently authored holdout
two runs with changed case order confound stochastic and order variation
positive non-direct cases validate proposed routes, not unique route selection
model aliases requested; resolved revisions and per-agent billing not exposed
synthetic code traces are not proof the repository exhibits every sample bug
